guitar.guitaristsText: Mick Ronson / Carlos Alomar / Earl Slick
guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul (Ronson) / Fender Stratocaster / Telecaster
guitar.notes: Bowie used many different guitarists across eras with no single signature instrument tied to Bowie himself; medium is appropriate given Ronson's well-known Les Paul.

tone.target: bright Nile Rodgers clean funk rhythm with tight quack
tone.profile: bright Nile Rodgers clean funk rhythm with tight quack
tone.summary: A bright, highly compressed rhythm tone emulating a Stratocaster through a Fender-style 2x12 cabinet, optimized for staccato funk playing.
corrections: favor quack over punchy mid lead
